question: According to the reactivity series, iron is more reactive than ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**copper**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The reactivity series is a list of elements ordered by their reactivity.
 
• Iron is more reactive than copper in the reactivity series.
 
• Reactivity of metals is an important concept in chemistry, influencing how metals are used and extracted.
